question_text: Was the Allstate website and app outage a cyberattack?
answer_text: Nobody has shown either way. Allstate has not said what caused the outage that began on Nov 23. Newsweek says there is no public evidence of a cyberattack, and no source we read says there was one.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: An Allstate statement naming the cause, or a regulator or investigator saying what happened.
Allstate saying service is restored, or outlets reporting that customers can sign in and use the app again.
An Allstate statement on whether any customer information was affected.

question_text: Is the Allstate outage linked to the other recent US outages?
answer_text: Not on any evidence we have seen. Officials quoted by TechCrunch said recent outages came from system upgrades, not cyberattacks, but did not single out Allstate. Newsweek says nothing shows a common cause.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Allstate naming its cause, or officials saying which outages their statement covered.
